title: Dental PPO Plans Other-Carrier Adjustment of the Requested Payment on Claim Appeals
content:
Under the Dental PPO Plans, the other-carrier adjustment of the payment requested on a second-level post-service appeal under the claim-appeal rule follows the primary payment recorded on the decision under appeal, and so decides the amount in dispute.

- **Primary payment above 0.00, non-duplication plan** (Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250): the requested normal benefit is reduced by the primary payment, never below zero.
- **Primary payment above 0.00, standard coordination of benefits plan** (Plus 1500, Premier 2000, Elite 2500): the requested payment is limited to the allowed amount less the primary payment.
- **No primary payment recorded:** no adjustment.

The reduction acts on the requested normal benefit; the limit then applies to the requested payment, ahead of the annual-maximum ceiling.

**Hypothetical.** Requested normal benefit 205.60, allowed amount 257.00, primary payment 140.00: Value 1000 gives 65.60; Premier 2000 gives the lesser of 205.60 and 117.00, which is 117.00.
